phase: Phase 0 — Repository truth, re-measured in a clean checkout
method: Every row below was executed in this session, in a worktree created fresh from the branch with `npm ci` from the committed lockfile. Nothing is carried forward from a prior record. Where a measurement disagrees with a previously published one, the previous value is named so the drift is visible rather than silently overwritten.

whyAFreshWorktree.problem: The session opened on `claude/vigilant-raman-9a439a`, a Lovable-sync branch holding 34 src/lib modules and none of the OCADE programme — no scripts/, release/, audit/, extension/, relay/ or vitest.config.ts. Any gate run there would have measured a pre-OCADE baseline and reported it as OCADE's.
whyAFreshWorktree.obstacle: Switching in place was refused, correctly: untracked android/, ios/ and native/ directories in that worktree collide with tracked files on this branch. `git clean` is forbidden by the operating rules, and deleting the owner's untracked files to win an argument with git is not a fix.
whyAFreshWorktree.resolution: `git worktree add` at .claude/worktrees/ocade-impl. Non-destructive, leaves the other worktree untouched, and yields a genuinely clean checkout — which is what exposed defect D19 below.

defectsFoundAndFixedThisPhase.title: A test that passes only on a machine with a stale build lying around — and would have made CI red
defectsFoundAndFixedThisPhase.found: src/lib/__tests__/release-gate-enforces.test.ts > 'restoration held' > 'passes again on the restored ledger and still reports it as blocked'
defectsFoundAndFixedThisPhase.symptom: AssertionError: OCADE release source gate failed (1/51 checks): production output is missing; run npm run build first
defectsFoundAndFixedThisPhase.cause: The test required `check-release-source.mjs` to exit 0. That gate verifies .output/server/wrangler.json (line 147), which only exists after `npm run build`. ci.yml runs 'Unit tests' BEFORE 'Production build', so the build output cannot exist yet. It passed on the development machine only because earlier builds had left .output/ behind.
defectsFoundAndFixedThisPhase.materialConsequence: The web job in CI would have failed at the Unit tests step, on every push, for as long as this test has existed. CHECKPOINT.md concluded 'a green run is likely' from local success. That conclusion was wrong, and it is exactly the failure mode hosted evidence exists to catch.
defectsFoundAndFixedThisPhase.fix: The suite's subject is the ledger, not the build. The restoration test now accepts the single build-output prerequisite failure and asserts that NO ledger check failed — overstatement, incompleteness, version drift, secret-shaped values and approval boundaries are all still required to pass.
defectsFoundAndFixedThisPhase.provenByMutation: Setting release/OCADE_RELEASE_BLOCKERS.json status to 'ready' fails the new assertion at line 142. Ledger restored byte-identically afterwards, sha256 7ABB3FCF21CD4F22FAA34CABADA69E6800FD5F33BF8BE69C94D9A305435615C5, git reports no change.

defectsFoundAndFixedThisPhase.title: A gate that crashed instead of failing, and was excluded from CI to hide it
defectsFoundAndFixedThisPhase.symptom: Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '.../.claude/OCADE_STAGE_2_SPEC_HASHES.json' — an unhandled exception at module load, before a single check ran.
defectsFoundAndFixedThisPhase.cause: It read a gitignored, machine-local provenance snapshot unconditionally, and that snapshot pins ABSOLUTE paths under C:\Users\haans\. ci.yml excluded the gate by comment for this reason, which also left its 175 repository-intrinsic checks — schema, phase scoring, arithmetic, evidence paths, all tracked — unverified by CI as collateral damage.
defectsFoundAndFixedThisPhase.fix: Intrinsic and provenance checks are now separated. Intrinsic checks always run. Provenance checks are reported as SKIPPED by name with the reason when their snapshot is absent, and are never counted as passed: absence of a check is not a passing check. The gate is re-enabled in ci.yml.
provenByMutation: Intrinsic: corrupting readiness.stage2Source to 99 produced 'gate failed (3/175 checks)', exit 1.

Provenance: with the snapshot present the gate runs 186 checks instead of 175; corrupting a recorded spec sha256 produced 'gate failed (2/186 checks)', exit 1, naming both the recorded-value mismatch and the on-disk mismatch.
